none: PAS NLM-C2F5B6: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), issue of 330-335, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Diademed and cuirassed bust right. Reverse description: Two soldiers with probably two standards between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Cliff Reeves kindly examined this worn coin. Diameter: 15.1mm, Weight: 1.61gms, die axis: possibly 12
